summary: Keep Pipecat; keep the same models. Resident Parakeet reduced median STT from 487.6 to 52.3 ms (35/35 exact paired outputs). Whistle is a smaller optional CPU alternative with recognition errors here; Rustvani is a working isolated prototype, not the production replacement.
caveats: Compare within an experiment group, not across unrelated corpora or timing boundaries.
Six English speech fixtures plus silence and five repeats are a smoke corpus, not a broad quality study.
Generated PCM is not audible speaker onset; missing measurements stay null.
All models remain local and below 8 GB of weights each. Runtime RAM/VRAM is a different budget.

latency_p50_ms.label: STT adapter median
latency_p50_ms.description: Completed PCM utterance to transcription result; includes a fresh process/model load in CLI mode, but not in an already-loaded resident worker. Silence fast paths excluded.

latency_p95_ms.label: STT adapter p95
latency_p95_ms.description: Descriptive interpolated 95th percentile of successful speech requests in this small fixed corpus. Check failure counts separately; not a production service guarantee.

wer_pct.label: Word error rate
wer_pct.description: Word edits / reference words over successful speech attempts, with Unicode case/punctuation folding but no number rewriting. Formatting differences can count as errors; entity checks add a semantic view.

cer_pct.label: Character error rate
cer_pct.description: Character edits / reference characters under the same normalization. Lower is better; a tiny English corpus does not establish broad accent/noise quality.

probe_accuracy_pct.label: Name / number probe accuracy
probe_accuracy_pct.description: Matched named-entity/number probes, allowing documented spoken/written number alternatives. Missing probes are not scored as zero.

first_answer_p50_ms.label: LLM first answer median
first_answer_p50_ms.description: LLM request to first actual answer-text token/frame, not an empty chunk, internal thinking token or tool result. Prompts/history must match before comparing engines.

first_pcm_p50_ms.label: TTS first generated PCM median
first_pcm_p50_ms.description: TTS synthesis request to first PCM chunk; may contain leading silence. This is not browser playback or physical speaker onset.

agent_ttfa_p50_ms.label: Agent generated-audio TTFA median
agent_ttfa_p50_ms.description: Inline VAD stop notification to first generated TTS PCM. Excludes the earlier configured 600 ms endpointing wait, network, browser playout and speaker hardware.

server_speaking_p50_ms.label: Server speaking-event median
server_speaking_p50_ms.description: Inline VAD stop to server BotStartedSpeaking event, kept separate from first generated PCM and from acoustic onset.

headless_first_pcm_p50_ms.label: Headless completed-input → PCM median
headless_first_pcm_p50_ms.description: Rustvani experiment: injected completed utterance to PCM sink, with full LLM-reply buffering. No VAD, browser transport or barge-in. NOT comparable to streaming browser TTFA.

browser_playback_ms.label: Browser / acoustic onset
browser_playback_ms.description: Not measured. Decoded audio energy proves received non-silent audio, not the time a human heard it.

runtime_rss_mib.label: Sampled process-tree RSS
runtime_rss_mib.description: Sampled RSS of the experiment process tree; excludes the preexisting Ollama daemon. Sampling can miss peaks; not total host RAM.

checkpoint_mib.label: Checkpoint size
checkpoint_mib.description: Bytes on disk / 2^20. NOT runtime RAM or VRAM. All selected model files are under the user's 8 GB per-model limit.

native_mel_p50_ms.label: Native mel median
native_mel_p50_ms.description: Native feature extraction counter for successful resident speech requests. Zero/unreported counters remain missing; marginal medians must not be added together.

native_encode_p50_ms.label: Native encoder median
native_encode_p50_ms.description: CUDA encoder counter for successful resident speech requests, with the same precision and checkpoint. First inference can include kernel warmup.

native_decode_p50_ms.label: Native decoder median
native_decode_p50_ms.description: Host decoder counter for successful resident speech requests. No OpenBLAS was linked in this comparison.

total_p50_ms.label: Request lifetime median
total_p50_ms.description: Per-stage request lifetime through completion or cancellation cleanup. Check per-sample outcomes; TTS can include streaming backpressure.

rtf_p50.label: Real-time factor median
rtf_p50.description: Processing seconds / generated or submitted audio seconds. Below 1 is faster than real time; does not measure browser delivery.

comparisons.label: Rustvani isolated prototype
comparisons.boundary: Injected completed utterance → PCM sink; no browser or VAD
comparisons.methodology: Two actual public-utterance round trips through the Rust framework, existing local model services and a bounded stdio bridge. Warm Phonon and Ollama; STT still uses the fresh CLI.
notes: Actual framework handoffs were tens of microseconds in these two runs; not evidence that rewriting orchestration will improve model latency.
Keep Pipecat in production. Rustvani is feasible, but not a drop-in browser replacement.
Tool-calling registry exists upstream, but sequential execution, deadlines/schema enforcement and browser transport need further validation.
limitations: Only two runs, no comparative Pipecat headless control.
Full LLM reply buffered before TTS: unlike the production streaming pipeline.
Browser transport, history, barge-in, reconnect and tool execution not exercised.
RSS excludes existing Ollama; sampled total GPU is device-wide and can miss peaks.
Upstream default logs/providers and tool-loop semantics require further integration work.

environment.browser_scope: Chromium on GPU host through private HTTPS; separate remote device unverified

next_decisions: Adopt resident Parakeet on this verified host; CLI stays the portable default and rollback. No model or decoding-quality changes.
Keep Phonon Rust CPU and Ollama Qwen unchanged: no measured evidence yet for a quality-preserving TTS/model migration.
Optional next experiment: separately measure a local OpenBLAS decoder build. Do not mix kernel and residency changes in one claimed gain.

Before tool calling: preserve complete call/result history groups, use native structured calls, budget enough tokens for valid arguments, and measure valid-arguments/tool execution/post-tool answer latency. Tool calling is not implemented or tested by this work.
Keep endpointing at 600 ms until a cutoff-quality corpus supports changing it. Generated audio latency is not acoustic latency.
